profile.legalName: San Joaquin County Office of Education
profile.summary: The San Joaquin County Office of Education is a regional public education agency in Stockton, California. It provides leadership, resources and services to school districts in the county, including special education programs. Its CEDR Systems department manages the Special Education Information System (SEIS), a web-based system used by California school districts to write and store special education plans (IEPs) and student records.
